name: Maternity leave
authority: Employment Act 1955 s.37(1)(a) read with s.37(1)(d)(ii) — maternity leave of not less than ninety-eight consecutive days. The LEAVE is unconditional and is what this row grants. Applied 2026-09-18: a grant per confinement (`event.kind == "BIRTH"`). The leave is unconditional; the maternity allowance is paid where she was employed in the four months before confinement and ninety days in aggregate in the nine before it (read as three months’ service) and has fewer than five surviving children besides the newborn (s.37(2)(a), s.37(1)(c); `pay_fraction`). Applied 2026-09-18 (2): EA s.37(2): the maternity allowance is payable where she was employed at least ninety days in the nine months before confinement and at some time in the four months before it; the leave is hers regardless (s.37(1)). Read as three months’ service on the day (`pay_fraction`): a shorter service takes the leave unpaid. Applied 2026-09-18 (3): s.37(2)(a) counts the ninety days in aggregate, with any employer: days employed elsewhere in the nine months before the confinement are declared on the child (`employee_children.prior_employment_days`, read as `event.prior_employment_days`) and added to this employment’s service. Applied 2026-09-19 (2): EA 1955 s.37(1)(b)?: no maternity allowance where at the time of confinement she has five or more surviving children (`children.count >= 6` with the newborn recorded); the leave itself is not conditioned.

name: Hospitalisation leave
authority: Employment Act 1955 s.60F(1)(bb) — 60 days of paid sick leave in the aggregate in each calendar year where hospitalisation is necessary, IN ADDITION to the s.60F(1)(aa) days since the Employment (Amendment) Act 2022 deleted the former 60-day aggregate proviso. Certification is required. No proration.

name: Medical leave
authority: Employment Act 1955 s.60F(1)(aa)(i)-(iii) — 14, 18 or 22 days of paid sick leave in the aggregate in each calendar year by length of service, where no hospitalisation is necessary. s.60F(1) makes examination by a registered medical practitioner or dental surgeon, or by a medical officer, a condition of the entitlement, so a certificate is required from the FIRST day; s.60F(2) deems sick absence without that certificate to be absence without leave. s.60F carries no proration clause and the entitlement must not be prorated.

name: Annual leave
authority: Employment Act 1955 s.60E(1) — 8 days of paid annual leave for less than two years of continuous service, 12 days for two but less than five, and 16 days for five or more. The closing words of s.60E(1) give an employee who has not completed twelve months of continuous service during the year in which the contract terminates an entitlement in direct proportion to the number of COMPLETED MONTHS of service, which is the proration below. Applied 2026-09-18 (2): EA s.60E(1): a fraction of a day under a half is disregarded and a half or more is a day (`rounding: WHOLE_DAY`).

name: Paternity leave
authority: Employment Act 1955 s.60FA — seven consecutive days of paid paternity leave per confinement for a MARRIED male employee who has been employed by the same employer for at least twelve months immediately before the leave begins (s.60FA(1) and (3)(a)); the eligibility predicate carries all three conditions. Not modelled: the s.60FA(3)(b) requirement that the employee notify the employer of the confinement at least thirty days before the expected confinement or as early as possible after it — neither has a home in the entitlement shape. Applied 2026-09-18: seven days per confinement (`event.kind == "BIRTH"`), up to five confinements in a lifetime irrespective of the number of spouses (s.60FA(1), (2); `lifetime_events`).
